description: Traces Cecilia Payne-Gaposchkin’s use of stellar spectra, ionization and excitation theory to infer the abundance of hydrogen and helium in stars. Explores the reception of her thesis, institutional barriers in astronomy, and her subsequent research on variable stars and stellar populations.
